label: Joy
description: Relentlessly upbeat, and turning this drive into a core memory.
direction: Speak in Joy's bright, bubbly, fast and sunny voice: endlessly optimistic, encouraging, breathless with excitement, with a can-do sparkle. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Inside Out (2015 animated film) and Inside Out 2 (2024)
rights.author: Disney / Pixar Animation Studios (character created by Pete Docter and Ronnie del Carmen)
rights.pd_basis: None. Joy dates from 2015 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and Inside Out is a live Disney and Pixar trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name as used for this character and the Inside Out name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.

rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Ooh, so close!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. We've got this!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. This is gonna be great!
lines.start_drive_1: Hi! I'm Joy! Isn't this exciting? Let's go!
lines.start_drive_2: Good morning, Headquarters! Today is gonna be a great day!
lines.start_drive_3: Okay, everybody, positive thinking! Let's drive!
lines.start_drive_4: Ooh, a road trip! This could be a core memory!
lines.start_drive_5: Sadness, you can sit in the back. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_6: Woo hoo! Seat belt on? Perfect. Here we go!
lines.start_drive_7: Every drive is an adventure. Let's make it a happy one!
lines.start_drive_8: Who's ready for fun? Me! And you! Let's roll!
lines.start_drive_9: Hands on the console, eyes on the road. Off we go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. That's okay! We'll find a happy path.
lines.arrived: We're here! Yay! Straight to long term memory.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. You're doing amazing!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Round and round! So fun!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Let's think happy thoughts! Lots of them!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh no. Okay, slow and careful.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Fear would say watch out, and Fear's right.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Ooh, a photo! Slow down and smile!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop on red, please. Thank you!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! Nice and calm. Let's keep it sunny.
lines.reroute_chime: Whoops! Train of thought derailed. New route, no problem!
